items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: the little country boy, Shrewsbury, going up there

ctx.x: We're number four. Role number four. Okay, still with Tommy Ridgely. Right. Okay, we were talking about you being in the Navy.

Yeah, okay, yeah, well I wound up with the GED. And, you know, first of all, I went to go into Great Lakes, Illinois, and I took this training, went up there, you know, that's what we didn't talk about, the little country boy, Shrewsbury, going up there. I went up there without an overcoat in December, Chicago, cold, froze to death. And I remember I had a zoot suit. You had a zoot suit?
Can you tell me what a zoot suit was?
